description: This file contains test cases for a FastAPI application, focusing on security features such as HTTP Basic Authentication and OpenAPI schema validation. It uses pytest fixtures and FastAPI's TestClient to perform various authentication and endpoint tests.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports the appropriate FastAPI app module based on the test parameter and returns a TestClient instance.

methods.name: test_security_http_basic(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests successful authentication with valid username and password via Basic Auth.

methods.name: test_security_http_basic_no_credentials(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests access to the endpoint without credentials, expecting a 401 response.

methods.name: test_security_http_basic_invalid_credentials(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests access with an invalid Basic Auth token, expecting a 401 response.

methods.name: test_security_http_basic_non_basic_credentials(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests an authorization header with a non-Base64 token, expecting a 401 response.

methods.name: test_security_http_basic_invalid_username(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests access with an incorrect username, expecting a 401 response.

methods.name: test_security_http_basic_invalid_password(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests access with an incorrect password, expecting a 401 response.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Validates the OpenAPI schema returned by the FastAPI application.
